input.question: What did William I do? I only read about Bismarck. (German Empire 1871-1888)
input.ground_truth: William is reported to have often said "It is difficult to be an emperor under such a chancellor[meaning Bismark]". William did the duty of a constitutional monarch, he found the most talented man in the country then put him in charge.
